notes.title: The FBC: Firebreak Closed Technical Test is Open
notes.content:
Welcome to the FBC: Firebreak Closed Technical Test!

Thank you so much for taking the time to play this in development version of the game! The Closed Technical Test is now open until May 19th for all invited players. Please read below for important information about the Closed Technical Test.

Purpose of this Closed Technical Test
With this build of the game, we are first and foremost testing the crossplay match-making and online features of FBC: Firebreak, utilizing a large group of global players and trying to iron out most of the issues before the game launches on June 17th.
Nondisclosure agreement
Remember, you have signed a nondisclosure agreement for this Closed Technical Test. This means that:

You are not allowed to discuss the contents of the test with others, including the fact that you are participating in the Closed Technical Test.
You are also not allowed to discuss the game with others or show it to others.
You are not allowed to stream the game or post videos online.

Simply put, don’t talk about the game or Closed Technical Test with others outside this forum or our private Discord Channels on the official FBC: Firebreak Discord server. For information on how to get access to the private Discord channels, please read through our Closed Technical Test FAQ.
Timing of the Closed Technical Test
The Closed Technical Test will run from May 15th  6AM PDT / 9AM EDT / 2PM BST / 4PM EEST until May 19th 1:59PM PDT / 4:59PM EDT / 9:59PM BST / 11:59PM EEST..
Where is my game key?
You can find your platform specific key for the platform you chose in your Firstlook dashboard.
How do I install the game?
Please check out our Closed Technical Test FAQ for platform specific instructions on how to install the game.
Where can I report bugs/issues I found?
Use the Closed Technical Test's Steam forums to report any bugs/issues you find. Alternatively, you can also use our private Discord Channels on the official FBC: Firebreak Discord server. For information on how to get access to the private Discord channels, please read through our Closed Technical Test FAQ.
Where can I find others to play with?
You can use the private channels in the official FBC: Firebreak Discord server to find others to play with. For information on how to get access to the private Discord channels, please read through our Closed Technical Test FAQ.
Is there crossplay?
Yes! Crossplay is available between all platforms. However, during maintenance crossplay will be disabled so there might be some brief times when crossplay is not available.
FAQ
For any further questions, check out our Closed Technical Test FAQ.
Known Issues
You can find our list of known issues here.

IT'S TIME TO CLEAN HOUSE
